activation.note: Activation retains whole-plan coverage, including pre-existing orphans and plans with WMBTs but no features. No-WMBT plans satisfy the invariant vacuously; extra references alone do not violate this one-way minimum. Change scenarios are examples, not exclusive triggers. File kind is directly inspectable, while phase and validator findings explicitly require new observers.
